title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the gravitational red shift as a function of gravitational potentials.

title: Use of g00
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Riemannian metric components g00 for both the sun and the earth in their derivation.

title: Proper Time Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the relationship between the emitted and observed frequencies using proper time intervals.

title: Gravitational Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the gravitational potential energy per unit mass in their calculations.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide justification for the approximation used in the final expression for the red shift.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of the red shift expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
